create_mutox_model: create a Mutox Classifier model from a MutoxConfig with optional device and dtype
build_mutox_classifier: build a MutoxClassifier model using MutoxClassifierBuilder with config, device, and dtype
configure_mutox_builder: configure a MutoxClassifierBuilder with MutoxConfig and optional device and dtype parameters
build_model_from_builder: build a MutoxClassifier model by calling build_model on a MutoxClassifierBuilder instance
create_mutox_with_device: create a Mutox Classifier model on a specific device and data type using create_mutox_model
